Team —

We're at T-minus 48 hours for the quarter close. Quick, focused asks so finance can lock numbers by end of Friday: 

1) Commit inventory (attached): open the CSV and mark every row with ONE of these values by EOD tomorrow: COMMIT (legal approved + PO/paid), COMMIT-PENDING-PO (contract signed, PO expected), AT-RISK, NO-GO. Put the estimated PO date where applicable.

2) Stage cleanse: update HubSpot stages to match the tracker. We need consistent stage names (Proposal, Contract, PO_PENDING, Closed-Won) — anything in Contract but without signatures should be PO_PENDING. 

3) Price/terms exceptions: flag in the tracker and copy David + Laura. If procurement/legal needs to re-open terms, note it in the comment column and set owner.

4) Customer confirmations: if you have externally committed dates (Kara at Acme, Nimbus procurement), add the confirmation email thread link in the tracker.

Attachments: commit_tracker_q1.csv (master), acct_rollup_slide.pdf (high-level rollup for CFO).

Why this matters: finance needs a clean commit file to finalize revenue for the quarter; anything we miss becomes a timing variance and creates churn with accounting. 

Quick format — one-line updates in the tracker, no long narratives. If you cannot get a PO by tomorrow, mark AT-RISK and include the blocker (legal, procurement delay, internal billing).

I'll run a five-minute readout at 08:30 PT Friday and publish the reconciled rollup.

Thanks —
Hannah
